proof_requests: Close-up photo of any embossed part number/logo on the headlight housing (to confirm actual make/model fit)
Photo of the rear of the unit showing connector, bulb sockets, clips, and brackets
Unwrapped photos of the lens in clear light from front and side angles
Short video of the headlight powered on and functioning
Clarification on why the watermark says 'Honda and Acura' while the text claims this is a Toyota part
response.reason: The seller's core claims (genuine Toyota OEM part, crack-free, complete clips/brackets) cannot be checked from one wrapped front-view photo, and the photo's own watermark contradicts the stated brand, so even a worst-case price is not yet safely groundable without the part number, rear view, and unwrapped lens shots.
